org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model

Class Procedure

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.procedure.model.Procedure

  • @Entity
public class Procedure
extends Object
    Database Entity class representing a single row in the Procedure table Includes Transient fields for RefBeamMap and ProcedureOutput and percentComplete Includes utility and convenience methods
